name: Lamar Advertising Company
business: Outdoor-advertising REIT: billboards (incl. digital), transit and logo signs across the US and Canada.

news.title: Q2 AFFO/share $2.40 (+8.1%); FY26 AFFO/share guide raised to $8.75–8.90
Shares slide with REITs as Treasury yields rise

cons: Ad spending is cyclical; growth only mid-single-digit (rev +{rg})
take: Stable income REIT with raised guidance; upside depends mostly on rates, so fundamentals are a mild plus, not a driver.

metrics.summary: Lamar Advertising Company is one of the largest outdoor advertising companies in North America, with over 362,000 displays across the United States and Canada. Lamar offers advertisers a variety of billboards, interstate logo, transit and airport advertising formats, helping both local businesses and national brands reach broad audiences every day.
